title: "Living so good, I swear": a montage of the life you're working toward
summary: Turn your goals into a short manifesting montage: AI shows future you reaching each one, and you cut it together with a single "I swear" line.
why: Virlo's TikTok trend tracker, updated November 26, 2026, lists a fresh "Living so good" affirmation format: 101 creators in the last seven days, peaking on November 22. Creators lip-sync the line over a montage of personal growth or a future they're manifesting, such as goals, travel and milestones. Our earlier montage packs looked back at your year; this one looks ahead.
steps: Write down four to six goals for next year that are about doing, not owning: a trip, a skill, a race, a cosy new routine.
Attach one clear selfie to ChatGPT or Gemini and use the main prompt once per goal, so each scene shows future you.
Optional: bring each still to life for two or three seconds in Kling or Veo with the video variation.
Cut the scenes together on TikTok or Reels with the trending sound, and add one short line like "2027 me, I swear".

prompts.label: Main prompt (one goal scene)
prompts.text: Use the attached photo of me. Keep my face, skin tone, hair and features exactly the same, so it clearly looks like me. Show me a year from now, living one of my goals: [GOAL, e.g. hiking a mountain trail in the Rockies at sunrise / crossing the finish line of my first 10K / reading in my own sunny little apartment / plating a dinner I cooked for friends]. Relaxed, proud, happy expression. Warm natural light, soft film grain, looks like a candid phone photo someone else took. Vertical 9:16. No text, no logos, no brand names, no other recognizable people.

prompts.label: Variation: bring it to life (Kling or Veo)
prompts.text: Use the attached image. Three seconds, vertical 9:16. Gentle, natural movement only: the person breathes, smiles slowly and glances toward the camera; hair and clothes move a little in the breeze; the camera drifts forward very slightly. Keep the face exactly the same. Calm, dreamy feel. No text, no logos, no other people.

prompts.label: Goal list and captions (text)
prompts.text: Help me plan a 15-second "future me" montage. Ask me three quick questions about what I want next year, then give me six goal scenes I could picture (about experiences, skills and habits, not money or possessions), one short on-screen line for each, and three caption options that make clear these are goals, not things I've already done.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business
prompts.text: I run [TYPE OF BUSINESS] in [CITY, PROVINCE]. Write a plan for a "living so good" Reel about where I hope the business goes next year: four goal scenes (for example a new workshop space, a first market stall, a class I want to teach), one on-screen line each and a caption. Present them clearly as goals, not results. No made-up sales, customer numbers, reviews or deals.

tips: Label it as goals or manifesting in your caption, so nobody thinks the AI scenes really happened.
Use the same selfie for every scene so future you looks consistent.
Experiences make a better montage than things: trips, skills and moments beat cars and shopping bags.
Save the montage and look back at it next November to see which goals you hit.
